environment: Local macOS Chrome headless, native WebGPU with GPU timestamps
method: Alternate reference/current, two warmups, median of measured runs; sampling plus density readback, excluding canvas coloring. GPU jobs run sequentially.

regressionComparison.reference: Working-tree GPU renderer before this performance fix; full-orbit replay with conservative per-histogram sample limits

validation: 45 actual worker/WebGPU full-orbit checks, including Preset-05 gradients, zoom, stationary and periodic trajectories, late motion, carry conversion, seeded subdivision and compact/noncompact queues
642 existing CPU/WebGPU escape and Buddhabrot orbit checks
Continuous readback/Stop density parity and locked zoom tests
Finite rendering asserts at most two density mappings, independent of sample/iteration count
note: Timing comparisons use compareDensity=false because the original intentionally discarded tail contributions. Full-orbit correctness is validated against an independent density oracle. These measurements do not establish equal speed for every formula, view or GPU.
